links.outcome: ChatGPT answer accuracy on 100 breast cancer questions versus expert-rated reference, four-point scale
links.effect: 5 entirely inaccurate, 22 partially accurate, 42 accurate but lacking comprehensiveness, 31 highly accurate; 27% of responses were inaccurate or only partially accurate.
links.quote: Of the 100 responses, 5 were entirely inaccurate, 22 partially accurate, 42 accurate but lacking comprehensiveness, and 31 highly accurate.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT answering breast cancer inquiries scored by clinical experts, with no comparative evaluation of a deployment guardrail.
